paper_title: Tell2Design A Dataset for Language-Guided Floor Plan Generation
caption: Number of floor plans vs. number of rooms per floor plan in the T2D dataset.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of floor plans corresponding to the number of rooms per floor plan. The horizontal axis displays the categories of room numbers, labeled from 4 to 8 in ascending order. The vertical axis represents the number of floor plans, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35,000, marked at intervals of 5,000. Each category is represented by a single blue bar. The bar for 4 rooms is the shortest, with a value of 254. The following bars increase in height, with 5 rooms having a value of 5,788, 6 rooms at 25,104, 7 rooms being the tallest at 29,278, and 8 rooms at 20,364. The bars are sorted in ascending order based on the number of rooms, with none of the bars visually emphasized beyond their color. A text is given on top of the graph "#Floor plan vs #Room per floor plan". No legend is given.
